signals.source_text: Modeling flight plan uncertainty usually creates a clear operational bottleneck. Strategic planners must choose between slow Monte Carlo simulations and simplified models that overstate risk and restrict airspace capacity. The framework generates realistic uncertainty profiles in under a second, eliminating over-conservative estimates without sacrificing accuracy. signals.source_text: I came across a MathWorks post this week, brilliantly narrated by Monica Wang , about REGENT Craft's Viceroy Seaglider, and I have not stopped thinking about it since. The Viceroy is an all-electric maritime vehicle that flies just above the water's surface, inspired by how birds like pelicans glide low over the ocean using ground effect to conserve energy. Turning that biological trick into a certified, human-rated vehicle is an extraordinarily hard engineering problem. The craft has to float on its hull like a boat at the dock, rise onto hydrofoils for stability and manoeuvrability as it picks up speed, then transition into full ground-effect flight within one wingspan of the water's surface at speeds up to 180 mph, and every one of those transitions has to be safe, repeatable, and predictable. Here is the part that genuinely excites me. Before this craft ever touched real water for crewed testing, REGENT engineers built the flight control stack using Model-Based Design in #MATLAB and #Simulink , modelling the vehicle and its full operating environment virtually. That means they could test and iterate on edge cases, failure conditions, and operating extremes long before putting a single physical prototype at risk. This is precisely the value of a digital twin. You can fail thousands of times safely before you fail expensively once in the real world. It connects directly to my own Master's thesis at the Universität Rostock , on large-scale data collection for fingerprinting-based indoor #localization , specifically in highly dynamic hospital environments where radio-reflecting equipment is constantly moving. Building a real-world dataset by hand in an environment that changes by the hour is close to impossible. A digital twin makes it tractable, and the resulting dataset is intended to train a neural network through unsupervised learning, powering downstream AI-based location prediction once deployed in the real world. Massive respect to the REGENT team and to CEO Billy Thalheimer for the engineering ambition here, and to MathWorks for building the tools making this kind of virtual-first development possible. #DigitalTwin #MATLAB #Simulink #Engineering #Innovation #localization

signals.source_text: Air traffic control (ATC) still runs on one of the oldest live communication mediums: bandwidth-limited AM radio, spoken in rapid, dense phraseology, where every instruction vanishes the moment it is heard. As a pilot, I witness the operational challenges that come with ATC communications firsthand. Today we're publishing a deep dive into the speech capability of ZEE, Archer's proprietary aviation foundation model. General-purpose models struggle with harsh radio acoustics and restricted jargon, and are unable to understand the nuances of aviation navigational terminology. For example the word "stick" near San Francisco is the SSTIK departure, while "stick" in North Carolina is spelled as STIKK. That nuance is not in the audio, and decoding that signal requires more than just good speech recognition. So we built ZEE differently: — A single speech engine that collapses voice activity detection, speaker diarization, and transcription into one model, emitting one speaker-attributed token stream. — Spatial grounding that injects location context so the model correctly transcribes local waypoints and procedures in any airspace. — A language model that decomposes each dense transmission into discrete, structured, verifiable commands. The result: 84% better accuracy than general-purpose speech models on aviation audio, and a 58% reduction in entity transcription errors from spatial grounding. All of it running in real time, offline, and on-device; so that pilots and controllers alike can benefit from this layer of intelligence. Every radio call becomes a permanent, scrollable, time-indexed record. And it lays the foundation for what comes next: catching readback errors and communication breakdowns in real time, before a misheard clearance becomes an incident. The next era of aviation safety should begin where it matters most: in cockpits and air traffic control towers. Preventing tragic, avoidable accidents starts by making communication clear and effortless in the sky. This is one of the missions behind ZEE, and behind everything my extraordinary team builds: a world where every single flight reaches its destination safely. Full post: https://lnkd.in/dvauVg2E

signals.source_text: Сегодня немного не про маркетинг. А про то, чему меня как отца научил мой сын Федор. В 2022 году Федор поступил в МФТИ БВИ (без вступительных экзаменов), став победителем Всероссийской олимпиады школьников. Сейчас он уже на 4 курсе МФТИ и параллельно работает в Yandex middle-разработчиком. А недавно записал свой первый подкаст - и рассказал в нем, как шел к этой победе. За этим результатом несколько лет подготовки, неудач и очень близких подходов к цели. В один год ему не хватило всего одного балла до призерства, в другой финал отменили из-за коронавируса. В 11 классе он вышел сразу в два финала - по информатике и физике. На информатике набрал 399 из необходимых 400 баллов для победы. И снова - буквально один балл. Но продолжил. Вышел на финал по физике - и там победил. Наверное, именно этим я горжусь больше всего. Не призом и даже не поступлением в МФТИ, а тем, что после очередного «почти» он не остановился. В бизнесе мы часто говорим про устойчивость и способность продолжать после неудач. А иногда этому стоит поучиться у собственных детей. Если у ваших детей сейчас олимпиады, экзамены или свой непростой путь к цели - возможно, история Федора будет им полезна. И поддержите его первый подкаст лайком, перейдя по ссылке ниже на канал - думаю, ему будет очень приятно. 🎙 https://lnkd.in/eTNvHKFZ Федя, горжусь тобой. Очень. ❤️
